behavior_matrix.expected: deterministic session_started envelope is ingested and repeated calls are duplicates
cards and canonical event search are returned with project/task filters
allowlisted evidence becomes ordered summary events with stable capture ids
reusing a capture id with changed content returns a conflict
session_ended is ingested and optional extraction/consolidation results are reported
all operations work through public localhost API or CLI without private desktop hooks

invariants: Bridge writes only through IngestService and existing extraction/consolidation services.
Repeated identities are idempotent; changed identity content is a conflict.
Manual evidence defaults to summary completeness and never copies hidden reasoning.
The bridge never changes existing card history or Project_J source files.
All generated event seq values are monotonic within a session.
rollback_or_recovery: Remove only bridge routes/CLI/tests or revert their additive code; canonical events and existing memory projections remain intact.

validation_plan.command: CLI/API smoke on a fresh SQLite database
